content.content:

ED SW Consult Note:
Per chart, patient is a 40 y.o. male who was BIBA and presents with hip pain x 1 week. Patient reports left hip pain and wound that has been gradually worsening since initial onset. Patient seeking assistance with housing. SW met with patient at bedside to introduce self/role and assess needs. Patient shared that he has been trying to get into Mercy House shelter. Discussed options to call Illumination Foundation and CityNet in addition to the other shelters given; encouraged the pt to continue to follow with Mercy House. Provided resources for Legal Aid per requests due to "My identity ws stole." Pt denied further needs and thanked SW. RN also at bedside.
SW remains available.
Electronically signed by Gulhan R at 02/11/2024 12:59 PM PST
